# Project Analysis: Story 3.4 Data Portability and Operational API

**Generated:** 2026-08-12  
**Generated by:** @architect (Vega)

Omnix is a TypeScript/Next.js brownfield application with Vitest, Supabase/PostgreSQL, CLI entrypoints and route-handler HTTP boundaries. The relevant existing services are the CSV/vCard contact parser, contact import preview/commit service, WorkspaceScope repositories, canonical contact commands, Smart Lists and connector-grade receipt/security patterns.

The feature requires external HTTP API integration and additive database changes. It should remain inside `packages/crm`, using domain/application/repository separation and narrow SQL RPCs. The detailed inventory, decisions, data flow, threats and tests are recorded in `data-portability-operational-api.md`.
